stem: Voltmarkt's position-based report credits €1.00 million across all rows, the unattributed row included, in a month when the webshop took €1.08 million, and no order was dropped. Many orders had only one or two touches. What is the likely bug?

options.text: Short paths got the 40% weights, so part of their revenue went uncredited
Middle touches got 20% each, so long paths were credited more than in full
Orders with no touch were put in an unattributed row instead of a channel
The last touch got 40% when the closing channel should get the other 60%
